title: Independent July 27
description: Poster design for a sold out show at the Independent July 27th, 2024.

title: EWEB & Every Thing Live
description: Poster Design for a night of super cool music at the Independent in San Francisco. The process for this design started with photographing sea shells at the beach.

title: Bolinas HRDWR
description: Poster for a night of music at the Bolinas Hardware Store, August 2023. The design went through a process of digital and analog manipulation before being printed on Kraft paper and pinned up around town. It was also featured on the cover of the Bolinas Hersay News that week in collaboration with Oliver Whitcroft.

title: Rattlecan Pale Ale
description: Rattlecan Pale Ale is a fictional identity completed in the Graphic Design 3 course with professor Lihn Dao at Cal Poly SLO. The idea for this project involved blending aesthetics of lo-brow and craft beers to create an approachable but refined Pale Ale. The Keywords, 8-hour-shift, and Sunday-drive were used to fuel the concept.

title: Elevated Weaving
description: A special visual identity project for the tree net builders at Elevated Weaving. Starting out in the Oak and Redwood trees of Northern California, this crew is a leader in innovative net building and design.

title: Marin Nicotine Prevention Program
description: A new logomark for a Marin County based program part of the non-profit, Bay Area Community Resources (BACR). Designed to be a public facing identity used for signage, flyers, events and other promotional material.

title: RB @ Pretty Gritty
description: Two posters to promote the label, Regular Beach, for a pop-up event at Pretty Gritty gallery in San Francisco. 24x38in.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
description: Poster and postcard concept designed with Tamar Rogoff and Sara Gierc for Rogoff's multimedia theater production at La MaMa in NYC.

title: Weather Report
description: 19x30in poster design for Mackenzie Huber and July Guzman's collaborative art show featuring new work at the Bolinas Gallery. The artists did not wish to feature their work as imagery for the design. Instead, objects relating to their concept were sourced and photographed for this project. A short animated version was made for social media.

title: 25th CMG Party
description: Animated Invitation celebrating CMG Landscape Architecture's 25th year in Business.
